jsonld_raw.name: (420 G) COFFEE CREAM SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Coffee Cream | The fragrance opens with the deep intensity of coffee, evoking the damp, fertile scent of the soil where coffee plants grow, rich and dark in the shade. At the heart, vanilla provides a warm and enveloping softness, like the temperate air flowing through the plantations at dawn. The base of Peru balsam leaves a resinous and ambery trail reminiscent of living earth, warm and deeply rooted.

Notes:
Top notes: coffee
Heart notes: vanilla
Base notes: Peru balsam

The candle comes in a cylindrical glazed ceramic container with an aged finish.
